faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Discovery D350 use?
faqLeft.a: The Discovery D350 uses the AJ300D — a 3.0-litre inline-six diesel from the Ingenium family, fitted to the D5/L462 generation from 2017 onwards with a mild-hybrid system.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Discovery D350 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,800. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Discovery D350?
faqLeft.a: The Discovery D350 uses the AJ300D. Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact spec before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ300D Discovery D350 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, guides, bearings, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every AJ300D rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Discovery D350 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Discovery D350 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Discovery D350 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Discovery D350 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
